_doc: The long videos of T3 (rsm.bench.long, docs/CONCEPT_test_strategy.md D). source: an id of clip_sources.json with a frozen stage `stage`; t0 must be 0 (the seconds of a long video are source seconds), dur: its length; case: the route case of regress_cases.json whose search frame, extract and score it takes; landmarks: the checkpoints of regress_landmarks.json. checks: min / max per score of rsm.bench.long.score (rsm.bench.clips.check), set from the first run with a margin (a regression bound, not a target). verdict: the verdicts that pass. known: a finding of the first run, reported, the checks are set around it.

long.why: the one ride with verified truth: timed scores of the whole pipeline (D6)
long.known: the scale scan of 10 min finds f_eff 355 instead of 423 (whole video): right road, but the route lags about 15 m along it (along median 17 m against 2 m of the whole video), T3 of 2026-11-20

long.why: odometry failure, disputed start, scene cuts: odofail, the local pass, islands, the verdict
